_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Commercial Derivative Aircraft (CDA) Airworthiness Certification Data
summary: Documents the certification process, substantiating data, and compliance artifacts for Commercial Derivative Aircraft (CDA), supporting the Government's FAA airworthiness type certification of the aircraft design.
use_relationship:
The Commercial Derivative Aircraft (CDA) Airworthiness Certification Data is used to document the certification process for CDA, substantiating data, and compliance artifacts. The data is used to support the Government's airworthiness type certification of the aircraft design. The data is limited to what is required by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) certification process. Additional data required by the United States Air Force (USAF) airworthiness process is separately addressed.

a. This Data Item Description (DID) is applicable to the acquisition and modification of CDA.
b. This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
c. This DID supersedes DI-SESS-81984.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The CDA Airworthiness Certification Data deliverable shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The CDA Airworthiness Certification Data shall contain the following:

children.title: FAA-approved airworthiness type certification process, planning, and compliance documents (refer to FAA Order 8110.4C, Type Certification, and FAA Order 8110.101A, Type Certification Procedures for Military Commercial Derivative Aircraft, copies of these documents are available online at https://www.faa.gov, for additional information)
Type Certificate (TC) and Supplement Type Certificates (STC)
Data necessary to manage the airworthiness seam (refer to FAA Order 8110.101A, for additional information)

FAA Certificates of Airworthiness (refer to FAA Order 8130.2J, Airworthiness Certification of Aircraft, copies of this document are available online at https://www.faa.gov, for additional information)
Special Airworthiness Certificate, Experimental Category
children.content: to perform research and development testing, show compliance, and FAA flight testing (including supporting airworthiness assessment, risk assessment, restrictions, and limitations)

children.title: Documentation of all Government-approved non-conformities with the FAA-approved type design
children.content: (refer to FAA Form 8130-31, Statement of Conformity - Military Aircraft, copies of this form are available online at https://www.faa.gov).

children.title: The applicable Distribution Statement
children.content: as necessary, in accordance with Department of Defense Instruction (DoDI) 5230.24, Distribution Statements on Technical Documents, Enclosure 4. (Copies of this document are available online at www.esd.whs.mil/DD.)

children.title: The applicable classification marking
children.content: as necessary, in accordance with Department of Defense Manual (DoDM) 5200.01, Volume 2, DoD Information Security Program: Marking of Information. (Copies of this document are available online at www.esd.whs.mil/DD.)
